prompt.generated_prompt_string: A vertical close-up portrait of a clearly adult woman centered and facing the camera with a gentle smile, sleek low bun with middle part, luminous natural skin texture, understated makeup, and calm sophisticated expression. She wears a strapless evening gown with metallic silver embroidery transitioning into bold three-dimensional red floral lace appliqués and a shimmering black sequined skirt creating a starry effect. Add a delicate gold necklace, drop earrings, stacked gold bangles on the left wrist, and soft iridescent manicure. Set the portrait at a fictional awards-ceremony gala with blurred green and white lights, no recognizable public figures or event branding. Use soft diffused event light at approximately 4500K with gentle warm fill, controlled sparkle on embroidery, red appliqués, sequins, and jewelry, an 85mm lens, realistic pores, accurate material texture, restrained dewy highlights, and subtle film grain. Use an approved adult model rather than a public-figure likeness.
